questions.prompt: Which sea did the Bronze Age Minoan civilisation dominate?
questions.fact: Their palaces have no fortifications, which suggests they relied on sea power rather than walls.

questions.prompt: Which instrument measures electrical potential difference?
questions.fact: It is connected across a component rather than in line with it, which is the opposite of how an ammeter is wired.

questions.prompt: In snooker, which ball is worth the most points?
questions.fact: It is worth seven, and a maximum break requires potting it after every one of fifteen reds.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character called Furiosa?
questions.fact: It was storyboarded before a script existed, and the boards ran to several thousand panels.

questions.prompt: Which mountain is the highest in Antarctica?
questions.fact: It was not seen by humans until 1958, discovered by aircraft rather than by anyone on the ground.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Lennie Small?
questions.fact: Its title comes from a Robert Burns poem about plans going awry.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym LiDAR measure using?
questions.fact: Archaeologists use it to find structures under forest canopy, which has rewritten the map of the Maya world.
